stem: A laboratory has a 400-gram sample of a radioactive substance. The mass \(M\), in grams, of the substance remaining after \(t\) days is modeled by \(M = 400\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{\frac{t}{6}}\). According to the model, after how many days will 50 grams of the substance remain?
solution: Since \(\frac{1}{8} = \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{3}\), the exponents must be equal: \(\frac{t}{6} = 3\).
verify:
t = symbols('t')
sols = solve(Eq(400*Rational(1, 2)**(t/6), 50), t)
assert sols == [18]
assert Rational(spr_answers[0]) == 18
